insc_Zhol

insc_Zhol
     
1. Content : The Zhol inscription
2. Location : south of the Potala Palace in Lhasa.
3. Date : post 763
4. Condition : extant
5. Photos / Rubbings :
Richardson (1952: opposite p. 1): East Face, South Face, ll. 48-68+, (1985: plates 2 and 3) same as or very similar to the preceding, larger and more clearly printed, Wang (1982: 7 plate 11) South face, lines 44-54.
6. References :
Waddell (1909-1911) [*], Wang (1982: 61-92) [I. Translit., I. Trans.], Bsod rnams skyid (1984: 50-76) [I. Translit., I. Trans.], Richardson (1985: 1-25) [I. Translit., I. Trans.], Li and Coblin (1987: 138-185) [I. Translit., I. Trans.], Khu (1996) [*], Chen and Wang (2003: 44-64) [I. Translit., I. Trans.].
